topic: Primary-source cross-check of Q2 2026 XRP ETF institutional positions: Goldman Sachs, Jane Street, Millennium Management and Intesa Sanpaolo

additional_security.relation: separate SPAC equity position; Armada is a party to Evernorth's proposed business combination

positions.interpretation: Direct listed XRP ETF share exposure plus separate indirect SPAC transaction exposure. Neither establishes direct XRP token ownership, Evernorth XRP custody or unhedged directional conviction.

The share-only sum matches the approximately $16.4M aggregator figure. The same filing also lists long call/put options. SEC Form 13F reports the underlying security reference for options; written/short options are not reported. Do not infer net delta or market direction.
The share-only total matches the approximately $16.2M aggregator figure. No 21Shares XRP ETF CUSIP was found in this filing. This is a Q2 listed-security snapshot, not a current or net position.
The approximately $14.4M aggregator figure is a single Grayscale XRP ETF position, not a basket across all five ETFs. The other four ETF CUSIPs were not found in Intesa's Q2 filing.

derived_concentration.limitation: The denominator is CryptoETF.today's aggregator-reported $179M, not an SEC consolidated total. Concentration percentages are conditional on that provider's universe, manager mapping and coverage.

sec_13f_methodology.publication_lag: Filings became public July 31 or August 14, 2026
sec_13f_methodology.q3_deadline_basis: 45 days after September 30 falls on Saturday November 14; SEC Rule 0-3 moves the deadline to the next business day, Monday November 16.
sec_13f_methodology.short_positions: Not included and not netted against long positions.
sec_13f_methodology.held_options: Long put/call options may be reported separately; columns refer to the underlying security, not the option premium.
sec_13f_methodology.accuracy: SEC states EDGAR acceptance does not establish substantive accuracy or correctness; filings are filer-submitted and not SEC-endorsed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large institutional managers and a European bank had reportable long exposure to XRP ETFs by June 30, 2026.
hypotheses.supporting: SEC filings directly verify Goldman, Jane Street, Millennium and Intesa positions.
hypotheses.counterevidence: 13F does not establish beneficial client ownership, investment motive, custody of XRP or net economic exposure.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Some reported positions may be associated with liquidity provision, options strategies, basis trading or facilitation rather than outright bullish conviction.
hypotheses.supporting: Jane Street's 13F includes common ETF shares and separate calls/puts; SEC rules omit short positions and written options.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The filings do not disclose the full strategy or all hedge instruments; directional and non-directional components cannot be separated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Goldman's separate Armada SPAC position creates an additional indirect financial connection to Evernorth alongside its XRP ETF holdings.
hypotheses.supporting: Goldman's SEC 13F reports $3.813M in Armada; Evernorth SEC filing identifies Armada as a business-combination party.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The SPAC position is not direct Evernorth equity or XRP; motive and hedges are unknown.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intesa's disclosed XRP ETF exposure is concentrated in Grayscale rather than distributed across the five-fund universe.
hypotheses.supporting: SEC filing lists $14.424M Grayscale XRP ETF; the other four fund CUSIPs were not found.
hypotheses.counterevidence: The 13F may omit confidentially treated or otherwise non-reportable positions and does not cover direct non-13F token exposure.

feature_store_rules: Store report_date separately from filing_acceptance_timestamp; make the position available to a point-in-time model only after filing acceptance.
Keep common ETF shares and option rows separate. Do not sum option underlying values into share holdings or interpret them as option premiums.
Do not infer net exposure: Form 13F omits short positions and written options.
Keep SPAC equity exposure separate from XRP ETF and direct token holdings.
Store CUSIP-level holdings to prevent institution-name-only misattribution.
Use Q3 2026 Form 13F updates only after their November 16, 2026 deadline and actual EDGAR acceptance; do not assume all managers file on the deadline.
Treat manager motives, client allocation and custody as unknown unless separately documented.

forecast.reason: Quarterly lagged listed-security ownership is descriptive institutional adoption evidence, not a calibrated short-horizon price signal.

next_actions: Capture Q3 2026 13F filings after November 16 and compare the same CUSIPs and manager entities.
Check whether Goldman, Jane Street, Millennium and Intesa amended Q2 filings before calculating quarter-over-quarter changes.
Cross-check Marex and the remaining top institutions directly against SEC CIK/13F information tables.
Track whether Jane Street's paired option rows persist, change or disappear in Q3; do not infer net delta from 13F alone.
Reconcile the institutional-holder aggregator's entity mapping and five-fund denominator before publishing aggregate concentration.
safety: Public SEC filings only. No private account data, access circumvention, trading, forecasting or real-money action.
